policies.acquisition_network: HTTPS to GitHub release/CDN and GHCR public pull/CDN endpoints only; anonymous public registry token stays in memory
policies.controller_install: standalone application bundle; retain signature and embedded provisioning profile; no Homebrew install
policies.archive_links: relative in-bundle symbolic links only; reject hard links, special files, absolute paths, traversal, symlink cycles and links escaping the bundle
policies.preflight_network: Tart --net-host; host-only networking still permits access to the host and other VMs on that segment
policies.image_trust: third-party CI image; templates disable guest SIP and include default automation credentials; verify live; no personal secrets or untrusted workload
policies.retained_acquisition: tool archive, extracted bundle, pinned OCI base and receipts; no automatic cleanup
policies.measurement_network: must be separately attested and approved before guest workload execution; host-only is not a no-host-access guarantee

stages.outcome: verified controller and pinned OCI image on disk; zero VM boot
one isolated VM with live version, runtime, SIP, login, network and free-space facts; no benchmark
exact executable guest/host ledger, negative tests, reviewed diff and commit
one complete build/install/test/reset/cleanup plus host residue and base integrity
all frozen timing, contamination, concurrency, VM loss, simulator loss, cancellation, caller loss and image update probes

limitations: Xcode 26.6 tag unavailable; acquisition of 26.5 needs explicit approval of the alternative guest profile.
OCI configuration proves architecture and disk layout, not Xcode/SDK/runtime identity or image safety.
The 140 GB guest disk may need separately approved expansion after free-space attestation; host disk space does not imply guest free space.
Tart --net-host uses host services and host network state; boot-side effects and ownership must be included in the VM preflight approval.
SIP-disabled guest results cannot be extrapolated to SIP-enabled production guests.
Do not equate APFS disk clones with suspended-memory restore; each admitted mechanism requires separate evidence.
Do not silently cap the four-namespace ramp to fit VM capacity; report unsupported or safety-stopped levels explicitly.
No executable VM measurement backend exists at the acquisition checkpoint; the native runner cannot be pointed at this VM.
No Gate 1 branch decision or raw measurement has been produced.
